summary: The diff implements a Settings screen with a persisted Admin Access toggle, an Admin screen guarded by that toggle (with a clear disabled message), a Callaway chart editor with persistence/validation utilities, and updates Callaway calculation/chart lookup to use the active (edited or default) chart. One notable extra behavior is periodic polling of the admin-access flag in the app shell, which was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: App-level periodic polling (setInterval every 500ms) to refresh admin access state.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requires the toggle to persist across reloads and to hide/show Admin navigation, but does not request periodic polling; state could be updated via normal React state/props/events.
